      .ind-hero-card__desc { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--codex-gray); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }
      .ind-hero-card__count { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); font-weight: 600; }

      .ind-section { margin-bottom: 3rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--codex-beige-light, #faf6f0); }

      .ind-section__header h2 { display: inline; font-size: 1.5rem; vertical-align: middle; }
      .ind-section__header h2 a { color: var(--codex-dark, #2a1f14); text-decoration: none; }
      .ind-section__header h2 a:hover { color: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); }
      .ind-section__header p { color: #666; font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0.4rem 0 0; line-height: 1.5; }
      .ind-section__cta { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); color: #fff; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.2s; }
      .ind-section__cta:hover { background: var(--codex-gold-dark, #96763e); color: #fff; }

      .ind-product-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
      .ind-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #f0ebe3; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }

      .ind-product-card img { width: 100%; height: 160px; object-fit: cover; background: var(--codex-beige-light, #faf6f0); }
      .ind-product-card__placeholder { width: 100%; height: 160px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #faf6f0 0%, #f0ebe3 100%); }
      .ind-product-card__body { padding: 0.8rem 1rem 1rem; }
      .ind-product-card__body h4 { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--codex-dark, #2a1f14); margin: 0 0 0.3rem; line-height: 1.35; }
      .ind-product-card__body p { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--codex-gray); margin: 0; line-height: 1.4; }

      /* ── Industry category product grid (on /industries/xxx/ pages) ── */
      .ind-cat-products { margin: 2.5rem 0; padding: 2rem 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--codex-beige-light, #faf6f0); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--codex-beige-light, #faf6f0); }
      .ind-cat-products__title { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--codex-dark, #2a1f14); margin: 0 0 0.3rem; text-align: center; }
      .ind-cat-products__sub { color: #666; font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; }
      .ind-cat-products__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
      .ind-cat-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #f0ebe3; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: all 0.2s; }
      .ind-cat-card:hover { border-color: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(41,28,14,0.1); transform: translateY(-3px); }
      .ind-cat-card img { width: 100%; height: 140px; object-fit: cover; background: var(--codex-beige-light, #faf6f0); }
      .ind-cat-card__placeholder { width: 100%; height: 140px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #faf6f0 0%, #f0ebe3 100%); }
      .ind-cat-card__body { padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.85rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
      .ind-cat-card__body h3 { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--codex-dark, #2a1f14); margin: 0; line-height: 1.3; flex: 1; }
      .ind-cat-card__arrow { color: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: transform 0.2s; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .ind-cat-card:hover .ind-cat-card__arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

      @media (max-width: 1024px) {
        .ind-sidebar { display: none; }
        .ind-layout { display: block; }
        .ind-hero-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
        .ind-section__header { flex-direction: column; }
      }
      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .ind-hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        .ind-header h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
        .ind-product-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      }

      /* Keep old classes for backward compat */
      .codex-industry-section { margin-bottom: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
      .codex-industry-section:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
      .codex-industry-title { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
      .codex-industry-title a { color: var(--codex-dark, #2a1f14); text-decoration: none; }
      .codex-industry-title a:hover { color: var(--codex-gold, #b08d57); }
      .codex-industry-desc { color: #666; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }

      .codex-footer-rfq-entry {
        margin: 0.75rem 0;
      }

      .codex-footer-rfq-link {
        min-height: 2.7rem;
        padding: 0.68rem 1rem;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.18);
      }

      .codex-footer-rfq-link:hover {
        color: #fff !important;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Product CTA Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-product-cta {
        margin: 1.35rem 0 2rem;
        padding: 1.35rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: 22px;
        background: var(--codex-bg-hero);
        box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-product-cta h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.55rem;
        font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 1.28rem + 0.35vw, 1.8rem);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__copy p:last-child {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__brief {
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__brief li + li {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Article FAQ (inside support panels)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-article-faq {
        margin-top: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-article-faq details {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
      }

      .codex-article-faq details:first-of-type {
        margin-top: 0;
        padding-top: 0;
        border-top: 0;
      }

      .codex-article-faq summary {
        cursor: pointer;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-article-faq p {
        margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Collection CTA Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Growth Hub Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-growth-hub {
        margin: 2rem 0;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top right, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 28%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero,
      .codex-growth-hub__group,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        padding: 1.25rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__group,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero h2,
      .codex-growth-hub__group h2,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.65rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero p:last-child,
      .codex-growth-hub__group p:last-child,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card {
        display: block;
        padding: 1rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), border-color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        border-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.3);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card-eyebrow {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card strong {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card span:last-child {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 0.45rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
        align-items: center;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief-list li + li {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Quote Brief — Redesigned CTA Section
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-quote-brief {
        margin: 2.5rem 0;
        padding: 2px;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.4), rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.15), rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.25));
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__inner {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem;
        border-radius: calc(var(--codex-radius-card-xl) - 2px);
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--codex-beige) 0%, #fff 40%, var(--codex-beige) 100%);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__eyebrow {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__copy h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__copy > p:not(.codex-quote-brief__eyebrow) {
        margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__cta {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 2.85rem;
        padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn--primary {
        border-color: transparent;
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.18);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.12);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn--primary:hover {
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.22);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__checklist {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item:first-child {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__step-label {
        padding: 0 1rem 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__icon {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.08);
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__icon svg {
        display: block;
      }

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-quote-brief__inner {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          padding: 1.5rem;
        }
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__action {
        min-height: 2.9rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Industry Selector (Homepage)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-industry-selector {
        margin: 2.5rem auto;
        padding: 0 1.5rem;
        max-width: 1200px;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        position: relative;
        padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
        border-left: 4px solid var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__eyebrow {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold-muted));
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card span:nth-child(3) {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__arrow {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
        color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        transition: transform 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card:hover .codex-industry-selector__arrow {
        transform: translateX(4px);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare {
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
        padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.7);
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare span {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-weight: 500;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare a {
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 500;
        transition: color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare a:hover {
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: underline;
      }

      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .codex-industry-selector__grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .codex-industry-selector__header h2 {
          font-size: 1.4rem;
        }

        .codex-industry-selector {
          padding: 0 1rem;
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Trust Bar
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-trust-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        margin: 2rem 0;
        padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: #fff;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        gap: 0.15rem;
        min-width: 120px;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item strong {
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item span {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
      }

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-trust-bar {
          gap: 1rem;
          padding: 1rem;
        }

        .codex-trust-bar__item {
          min-width: calc(50% - 1rem);
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Contact RFQ Form
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      #contact-rfq-form {
        scroll-margin-top: 7rem;
      }

      #contact-rfq-form .kb-text-style-field::placeholder {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Legacy Redirect Page
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-legacy-redirect-shell {
        min-height: 100vh;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        padding: 2rem 1rem;
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 26%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-bg-warm), rgba(255, 255, 255, 1));
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect {
        width: min(720px, 100%);
        padding: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect h1 {
        margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__lead,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__meta,
      .codex-legacy-redirect p:last-of-type {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details {
        margin: 1rem 0;
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details div {
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details dt {
        margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details dd {
        margin: 0;
        word-break: break-word;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__action {
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__action--primary {
        color: #fff;
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        border-color: transparent;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.14);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Editorial Pages
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-editorial-page {
        max-width: min(1160px, calc(100% - 2rem));
        margin: 0 auto 3rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
        padding-top: 3.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-subtle);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.4;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        word-break: break-word;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail a {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 44px;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-decoration-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.3);
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail a:hover {
        text-decoration-color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        align-items: center;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(280px, 0.9fr);
        padding: 1.75rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.16), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-heavy);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero h1 {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.7rem + 1vw, 2.8rem);
        line-height: 1.08;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      }

      /* Page-type hero color variants */
      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="solution"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-teal);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-teal-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="solution"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compare"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-steel);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-steel-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compare"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="guide"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-forest);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-forest-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="guide"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compatibility"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-answer {
        margin-top: 1rem;
        padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-gold);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      }

      .codex-editorial-summary {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-nav {
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
        padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-nav .codex-editorial-kicker {
        margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card {
        padding: 1rem;
        border-radius: 18px;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card p {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card p + p {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-weight: 700;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-link:hover {
        color: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .codex-editorial-points,
      .codex-editorial-list {
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-points li,
      .codex-editorial-list li {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-points li + li,
      .codex-editorial-list li + li {
        margin-top: 0.55rem;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta {
        margin-top: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
        background: var(--codex-gold);
        color: var(--codex-dark);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: opacity 0.15s;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta-btn:hover {
        opacity: 0.88;
        color: var(--codex-dark);
      }

      .codex-hero-trust-bar {
        display: flex;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        margin-top: 1rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-hero-trust-bar strong {
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-hero-trust-bar {
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          gap: 0.75rem;
        }
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-list {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding: 0 0 0 0.4rem;
        display: grid;
        gap: 0;
        position: relative;
      }

      /* Vertical connecting line */
      .codex-editorial-step-list::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(0.4rem + 2.45rem);
        top: 1.5rem;
        bottom: 1.5rem;
        width: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-border), transparent);
        z-index: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
        align-items: start;
        padding: 0.85rem 0.65rem;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-index {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 4.9rem;
        min-height: 2.2rem;
        padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.96), rgba(108, 81, 39, 0.96));
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-copy {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout {
        margin: 1.25rem 0;
        padding: 1.15rem 1.35rem;
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-gold);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout__link {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section a {
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 500;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section a:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
      }

      .codex-editorial-figure {
        margin: 1rem 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-figure img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
        object-fit: cover;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section,
      .codex-editorial-card {
        margin-top: 2rem;
        padding: 1.5rem 1.65rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 1.5rem 1.65rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[id],
      .codex-editorial-action-bar[id] {
        scroll-margin-top: 6rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section h2,
      .codex-editorial-card h2,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.8rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section p,
      .codex-editorial-card p,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar p,
      .codex-editorial-brief-card p,
      .codex-editorial-brief-card dd {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section p:last-child,
      .codex-editorial-card p:last-child,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-resource-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-link-card strong {
        display: block;
      }

      .codex-editorial-link-card span {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 1rem;
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card dt {
        margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card dd {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table-wrap {
        overflow-x: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: #fff;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }

      /* Scroll fade hint on small screens */
      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-editorial-table-wrap {
          background:
            linear-gradient(to right, #fff 85%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)) 100% 0 / 3rem 100% no-repeat,
            #fff;
        }
      }

      .codex-editorial-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table th,
      .codex-editorial-table td {
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        text-align: left;
        vertical-align: top;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        word-break: break-word;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th {
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th:first-child {
        border-radius: 13px 0 0 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th:last-child {
        border-radius: 0 13px 0 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
        background: rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.5);
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:last-child th,
      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody th {
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details {
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details + details {
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details:last-child {
        border-bottom: 0;
        padding-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary {
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 0.5rem 0;
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary::before {
        content: "+";
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 1.6rem;
        height: 1.6rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 400;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker {
        display: none;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details[open] > summary::before {
        content: "−";
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: transparent;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq p {
        margin: 0.45rem 0 0 2.25rem;
      }

      /* Inline RFQ form */
      .codex-inline-rfq {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 2rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--codex-dark) 0%, #3d2a14 100%);
        color: #fff;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-size: 1.35rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq p {
        margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-form {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-row {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-row input {
        flex: 1;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-family: inherit;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input::placeholder,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea::placeholder {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input:focus,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq button {
        align-self: flex-start;
        padding: 0.7rem 2rem;
        border: none;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: var(--codex-gold);
        color: var(--codex-dark);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: opacity 0.15s;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq button:hover {
        opacity: 0.88;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-inline-rfq-row {
          flex-direction: column;
        }
      }

      /* Trust signals */
      .codex-trust-signals {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-trust-stats {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 1rem;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-trust-stat strong {
        display: block;
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .codex-trust-stat span {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      }

      .codex-trust-note {
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        text-align: center;
        margin: 0;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-trust-stats {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        }
      }

      /* Pain point / solution / results section styles */
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="pain"] {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-error);
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: var(--codex-error-light);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="pain"] h2 {
        color: var(--codex-error);
      }
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="pain"] h2::before {
        content: "⚠ ";
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="solution"] {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-success);
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: var(--codex-success-light);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="solution"] h2 {
        color: var(--codex-success);
      }
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="solution"] h2::before {
        content: "✓ ";
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="results"] {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-gold-text);
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.04);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="results"] h2 {
        color: var(--codex-gold-text);
      }

      /* Callout semantic colors */
      .codex-editorial-callout {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-info);
        background: var(--codex-info-light);
      }
      .codex-editorial-callout strong {
        color: var(--codex-info);
      }

      /* FAQ answer link color */
      .codex-editorial-faq a {
        color: var(--codex-info);
        text-decoration-color: var(--codex-info-border);
      }

      /* Resource card link hover color */
      .codex-editorial-link-card:hover strong {
        color: var(--codex-gold-text);
      }

      /* Inline RFQ submit button color enhancement */
      .codex-inline-rfq button:hover {
        background: var(--codex-success);
      }

      /* Trust signals number color — use gold-text for AA contrast */
      .codex-trust-stat strong {
        color: var(--codex-gold-text);
      }

      /* Action bar: strong CTA treatment */
      .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 1rem;
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top right, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 40%),
          var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      /* FAQ shell: lighter, supplementary feel */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-faq-shell {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
        border: 1px dashed rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.15);
      }

      /* Snapshot / at-a-glance sections: left accent colored by page type */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      [data-page-type="compare"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      /* Resource sections: grid-heavy, no card wrapper feel */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-resource-shell {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        padding-left: 0;
        padding-right: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      /* Page-type colored action bar variants */
      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar .codex-editorial-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2c5454, var(--codex-teal));
      }

      [data-page-type="compare"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar .codex-editorial-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1b4332, var(--codex-forest));
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Conversion Blocks (Product & Article CTA)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-conversion-shell {
        margin: 2.5rem 0 2rem;
        padding: 1.75rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-hero);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-heavy);
      }

      .codex-conversion-header {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-kicker {
        margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-conversion-header h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.4rem;

RFID for Libraries — Self-Service, Automated Sorting and Rapid Inventory

Quick answer

Libraries worldwide use RFID to automate circulation, enable patron self-service, speed up collection inventory and protect materials from unauthorized removal. RFID-tagged books and media items pass through self-checkout kiosks, self-return stations and automated sorting machines — freeing staff from repetitive tasks and enabling libraries to serve more patrons with fewer manual processes.

  • Self-service circulation — patrons check out and return items at RFID kiosks without staff assistance, processing multiple items simultaneously.
  • Collection inventory in hours — handheld RFID readers scan shelves at walking speed, completing full collection inventories in a fraction of the time required for barcode scanning.
  • Security and anti-theft — RFID security gates detect unprocessed items leaving the building, replacing or supplementing traditional electromagnetic security strips.

How RFID benefits libraries

  • Staff productivity — automating checkout, return and sorting eliminates 60-80% of routine circulation desk labor, allowing staff to focus on reader advisory, programming and community services.
  • Patron convenience — self-service kiosks available during all open hours, including unstaffed periods, give patrons immediate access to circulation services without queuing.
  • Inventory accuracy — annual inventories that took weeks with barcode scanning now take days with RFID, and can be performed more frequently (quarterly or monthly) for better collection management.
  • Misshelved item detection — RFID shelf inventory identifies books placed on the wrong shelf, enabling staff to correct shelving errors that make items effectively invisible to patrons searching the catalog.
  • Interlibrary loan efficiency — RFID automates check-in and check-out of ILL materials, tracking items across participating libraries with minimal manual handling.
  • Space planning data — RFID usage data shows which collections are most heavily circulated, informing space allocation, collection development and weeding decisions.

RFID products for library deployments

  • Book tags — thin HF RFID labels (13.56 MHz, ICODE SLIX or compatible) applied inside book covers, available in square (50 × 50 mm) and rectangular formats with EAS security bit support.
  • Spine labels — narrow RFID labels designed to apply along book spines for collection inventory scanning from the aisle without pulling books from shelves.
  • CD/DVD/Blu-ray tags — hub-center circular RFID labels for optical media that do not interfere with disc playback or physical disc handling.
  • Patron RFID library cards — RFID-enabled cards (MIFARE or ICODE) serving as patron identification at self-service stations and door access points.
  • AV case labels — larger format labels for audiovisual packaging, boxed sets, media cases and multimedia kits.

FAQ

How much does it cost to tag an entire library collection with RFID?

RFID book tags cost $0.08-$0.15 per tag at volume. For a 100,000-item collection, the tagging cost is approximately $8,000-$15,000 for the tags themselves. Including staff labor for applying tags and encoding, the total tagging project typically costs $0.20-$0.35 per item, or $20,000-$35,000 for a 100,000-item library.

Are library RFID tags compatible with Bibliotheca and other system vendors?

Yes. We supply RFID tags compatible with all major library RFID system vendors including Bibliotheca, EnvisionWare, 3M/Tattle-Tape, Checkpoint, and FE Technologies. The standard chip (ICODE SLIX, ISO 15693) ensures cross-vendor compatibility. We configure the data model (item ID, AFI, DSFID) to match your specific system vendor's requirements.

Can RFID tags damage books?

No. Library RFID tags are thin (under 0.3 mm), flexible, and use acid-free adhesive designed for archival materials. The tags add negligible weight and thickness to the book. They contain no magnetic components that could affect magnetic media. Properly applied tags have no adverse effect on book condition and are used in national libraries and rare-book collections worldwide.
